summary: Cognyte Software Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on September 1, 2026, solely to announce a conference call scheduled for September 9, 2026, to review its second quarter fiscal year 2027 financial results. The filing includes a press release and details for investors to register for the call. This is a routine earnings schedule announcement by a foreign private issuer and does not involve any special-situation transaction such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring. No deal terms are present, and the filing has no bearing on corporate control or capital structure.
